# Admin API

45 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/audit`

List audit entries

List audit log entries, newest first (admin only). Two paging modes: offset paging (`page`/`per_page`, the default) and keyset paging (`cursor`). Keyset paging never counts rows or scans past an offset, so it stays fast on large tables; follow `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true. In offset mode `total` is exact when `total_exact` is true (small tables and the last page); otherwise it is the planner's row estimate (no filter) or a lower bound (with `actor`/`action` filters).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer | no | 1-based page number (offset paging). Ignored when `cursor` is present. Minimum: 1. |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | Opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page. Present but empty starts keyset paging at the newest entry. Selects keyset paging: the response carries no `page`, `total` or `total_exact`. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Paginated list of audit entries | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Malformed cursor | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [AuditEntry](schemas.md#auditentry) | no | - |
| `has_more` | boolean | no | True when entries follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | string | no | Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent when `has_more` is false. |
| `page` | integer | no | Offset paging only. |
| `per_page` | integer | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | Offset paging only. See `total_exact`. |
| `total_exact` | boolean | no | Offset paging only. False when `total` is an estimate or a lower bound. |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/audit/export`

Export audit log

Export the audit log as JSONL or CSV (admin only). Streams the log as a download without counting rows: entries are read in keyset pages (newest first) and flushed after every page, so memory stays bounded however long the log is. The body is chunked (no `Content-Length`); if the server fails after the response started the connection is aborted rather than ended normally, so a truncated file is detectable. In CSV, cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR are prefixed with `'` to defuse spreadsheet formula injection. Fields (stable; new fields may be appended): `id`, `timestamp` (RFC 3339, UTC), `action`, `actor`, `actor_type`, `actor_id`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `repository_id`, `project_id`, `ip`, `details` (JSON object; in CSV its JSON text). Unset values are `null` in JSONL and empty in CSV.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | query | string | no | `jsonl` (default): one JSON object per line. `csv`: header row plus one record per entry. One of: `jsonl`, `csv`. Default: `jsonl`. |
| `since` | query | string | no | Only entries at or after this instant: RFC 3339 timestamp or `YYYY-MM-DD` (00:00 UTC). |
| `until` | query | string | no | Only entries strictly before this instant (same forms as `since`); must be after `since`. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Audit export stream Headers: `Content-Disposition`. | `application/x-ndjson`: string; `text/csv`: string |
| `400` | Unknown `format`, malformed `since`/`until`, or `since` not before `until` | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys`

List GPG keys

Lists the database-managed signing keys plus the read-only entry for the key configured through gpg.keyPath / GPG_KEY_PATH (admin only). Private key material is never returned.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of GPG keys | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `can_store_keys` | boolean | no | False when OPENARTIFACT_SECRET_KEY is not set: keys cannot be imported or generated because private keys are only stored encrypted. |
| `keys` | array of [GPGKey](schemas.md#gpgkey) | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys`

Import GPG key

Imports an ASCII-armored private key (admin only). A passphrase-protected key is unlocked with `passphrase` and stored without it, sealed with OPENARTIFACT_SECRET_KEY. The key becomes the global active key when nothing signs globally yet, unless `activate` says otherwise.

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activate` | boolean | no | Make it the global active key; default: only when nothing signs globally yet |
| `name` | string | no | Unique display name; defaults to key-`<keyid>`. Maximum length: 255. |
| `passphrase` | string | no | Passphrase of a protected key |
| `private_key` | string | yes | ASCII-armored private key |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | GPG key imported | `application/json`: [GPGKey](schemas.md#gpgkey) |
| `400` | Invalid, protected (code passphrase_required), revoked or expired key | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | Name or fingerprint already exists, or OPENARTIFACT_SECRET_KEY is not set (code secret_key_required) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys/generate`

Generate GPG key

Generates a signing key pair on the server (admin only). The private key is stored sealed and never returned; export the public key with the export route.

**Request body**

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activate` | boolean | no | Make it the global active key; default: only when nothing signs globally yet |
| `algorithm` | string | no | One of: `ed25519`, `rsa4096`. Default: `ed25519`. |
| `comment` | string | no | - |
| `email` | string | no | - |
| `name` | string | no | Maximum length: 255. |
| `user_name` | string | no | User id name; default `OpenArtifact repository signing key` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | GPG key generated | `application/json`: [GPGKey](schemas.md#gpgkey) |
| `400` | Invalid input | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | Name already exists, or OPENARTIFACT_SECRET_KEY is not set (code secret_key_required) | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys/{id}`

Delete GPG key

Deletes a database-managed key (admin only). An active key (global or assigned to a repository) is refused with 409 key_in_use unless `force=true`; the repositories it signed are then re-signed by the next applicable key or become unsigned. The config key cannot be deleted.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Key id (UUID) or `config` for the read-only file/env key |
| `force` | query | boolean | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | GPG key deleted | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | GPG key not found | - |
| `409` | Key is active (key_in_use) or read-only | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys/{id}/activate`

Activate GPG key

Makes the key sign every deb/rpm repository without a key of its own (global scope), or only the named hosted deb/rpm repository when `repository` is given. Affected repositories are re-signed (admin only).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Key id (UUID) or `config` for the read-only file/env key |

**Request body**

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | string | no | Repository name; omit for the global scope |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The key | `application/json`: [GPGKey](schemas.md#gpgkey) |
| `400` | Repository is not a hosted deb or rpm repository | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Key or repository not found | - |
| `409` | Read-only config key | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/gpg/keys/{id}/activate`

Deactivate GPG key

Stops the key signing globally, or for the repository named in the `repository` query parameter (admin only).

Blob replication status

Backlog, lag, totals and the last verify pass of the replication to storage.replica (admin only). Reports enabled=false when no replica is configured. This static path takes precedence over /admin/storage/{name}.

### `POST /api/v1/admin/storage/replication/verify`

Verify the replica now

Requests a verify pass that compares the primary store with the replica and repairs differences in either direction; it runs in the background on the replica holding the verify lock (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Pass requested | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Blob replication is not configured | - |
| `409` | A verify pass is already running or requested | - |

Fields of the `202` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requested` | boolean | no | - |

| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/tiering/tiers`

List storage tiers

Lists the storage tiers (hottest first) with their placement: blob count and bytes per tier (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of tiers | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [StorageTier](schemas.md#storagetier) | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/tiering/tiers`

Create storage tier

Maps an existing storage backend to a named tier (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string | yes | Name of an existing storage backend. |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `promote_on_read` | boolean | no | - |
| `rank` | integer | no | Position from hot (low) to cold (high); defaults to after the last tier. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Tier created | `application/json`: [StorageTier](schemas.md#storagetier) |
| `400` | Invalid request | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | Name or backend already used by a tier | - |

Update storage tier

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/tiering/tiers/{name}`

Delete storage tier

Deletes a tier that holds no blobs and is not referenced by a policy; the primary tier cannot be deleted (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Tier deleted | - |
| `400` | The primary tier cannot be deleted | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Storage tier not found | - |
| `409` | Tier still holds blobs, has moves in progress or is used by a policy | - |
